name: insecure-registries: single entry
reason: non-empty insecure-registries list allows plaintext HTTP image pulls

name: insecure-registries: multiple entries
reason: multiple insecure registries configured

name: insecure-registries: clean empty array
reason: empty insecure-registries list is a no-op

name: insecure-registries: clean absent
reason: insecure-registries key is absent

name: icc: flag true
reason: icc true leaves inter-container communication enabled

name: icc: clean false
reason: icc false is the hardened value

name: icc: clean absent
reason: icc key is absent

name: no-new-privileges: flag false
reason: no-new-privileges false does not block privilege escalation

name: no-new-privileges: clean true
reason: no-new-privileges true is the hardened value

name: no-new-privileges: clean absent
reason: absent no-new-privileges key is not flagged (avoid false positives on older configs)

name: userns-remap: flag empty string
reason: empty userns-remap value disables user namespace isolation

name: userns-remap: flag none
reason: userns-remap set to "none" disables user namespace isolation

name: userns-remap: clean default
reason: userns-remap default is the hardened value

name: userns-remap: clean absent
reason: absent userns-remap key is not flagged by this rule

name: experimental: flag true
reason: experimental true enables unsupported/unstable daemon features

name: experimental: clean false
reason: experimental false is the hardened value

name: experimental: clean absent
reason: experimental key is absent

name: live-restore: flag false
reason: live-restore false kills containers on daemon restart/upgrade

name: live-restore: clean true
reason: live-restore true is the hardened value

name: live-restore: clean absent
reason: live-restore key is absent

name: tls: flag tls false only
reason: tls false leaves the remote API socket unauthenticated

name: tls: flag tlsverify false only
reason: tlsverify false leaves the remote API socket unauthenticated even with tls set

name: tls: flag both false
reason: both tls and tlsverify disabled leaves the remote API fully unauthenticated

name: tls: remote TCP host without TLS settings
reason: a TCP Docker API host without TLS settings is remotely unauthenticated

name: tls: clean both true
reason: tls and tlsverify both true is the hardened configuration

name: tls: clean absent
reason: tls/tlsverify keys are absent (local unix socket only)

name: combined: clean empty object
reason: empty daemon.json has no insecure settings to flag

name: combined: clean fully hardened
reason: CIS-hardened daemon.json trips no checks

name: combined: flag fully insecure
reason: every insecure setting present at once

name: non-object input: clean malformed json
reason: input that does not parse as JSON is out of scope for this rule

name: non-object input: clean json array
reason: a JSON array (not an object) is not a daemon.json document
